Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the primary bottleneck is the inefficient layout of the central repository relative to the work sites. The significant travel distances required for workers to retrieve tools and materials are causing lost productivity. To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing the repository by creating smaller, localized tool and material stations closer to the various construction areas, thereby reducing commute time and increasing overall worker productivity.
